remarks: Charming Condo for Rent in Silvermine Neighborhood.   Discover this inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the highly sought-after Silvermine Condominiums. With a prime location just steps from the Merritt 7 train station and close to the Merritt Parkway and Route 7, convenience meets comfort in this exceptional unit.  The condo boasts an open-concept layout, seamlessly blending the living and dining areas for modern living. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, and the unit is equipped with a washer and dryer for your convenience. Ample storage space is available on the lower level, ensuring everything has its place.  Relax on the private balcony, a perfect spot to unwind after a long day. The unit also comes with two assigned parking spots, adding to its practicality and convenience.  Whether commuting or working from home, you'll appreciate the blend of style, function, and a location that puts everything within reach.  Don't miss this opportunity-schedule your viewing today!
